metadata.question: In parts of East Midlands, northeast England, and eastern Scotland, was there more rain during October 1, 2023, and January 4, 2024 as compared to their 1991-2020 average rainfalls for those months?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need precipitation data for two specific dates: October 1, 2023 and January 4, 2024 - Need 1991-2020 average rainfall for October and January - Regions: East Midlands, northeast England, and eastern Scotland - Will use ERA5-Land daily aggregated precipitation data (meters) - For climatology: ERA5-Land monthly aggregated data for 1991-2020 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed - precipitation data doesn't need cloud masking - Just need to extract and compare values 3. Logic: - Calculate mean precipitation for Oct 1, 2023 and Jan 4, 2024 over the three regions - Calculate 1991-2020 climatological mean for October and January - Compare: If 2023/2024 values > climatology for both months → A (Yes) - Valid zero (no rain) is a legitimate value vs. null/missing data - Need to check if data exists and if calculations succeed ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define regions: East Midlands, northeast England, and eastern Scotland const eastMidlands = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-1.5, 52.5], [0.5, 52.5], [0.5, 53.5], [-1.5, 53.5], [-1.5, 52.5]] ]); const northeastEngland = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-2.5, 54.5], [-1.0, 54.5], [-1.0, 55.5], [-2.5, 55.5], [-2.5, 54.5]] ]); const easternScotland = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-4.0, 56.0], [-2.0, 56.0], [-2.0, 57.5], [-4.0, 57.5], [-4.0, 56.0]] ]); const regions = ee.FeatureCollection([ ee.Feature(eastMidlands, {name: 'East Midlands'}), ee.Feature(northeastEngland, {name: 'Northeast England'}), ee.Feature(easternScotland, {name: 'Eastern Scotland'}) ]); const combinedRegion = eastMidlands.union(northeastEngland).union(easternScotland); // Get daily precipitation data for specific dates const oct2023 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate('2023-10-01', '2023-10-02') .select('total_precipitation_sum') .first(); const jan2024 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate('2024-01-04', '2024-01-05') .select('total_precipitation_sum') .first(); // Check if data exists const oct2023Exists = await new Promise((resolve) => { ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate('2023-10-01', '2023-10-02') .size() .evaluate((size) => resolve(size > 0)); }); const jan2024Exists = await new Promise((resolve) => { ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate('2024-01-04', '2024-01-05') .size() .evaluate((size) => resolve(size > 0)); }); if (!oct2023Exists || !jan2024Exists) { console.log('Missing data for 2023/2024 dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean precipitation for 2023/2024 const oct2023Mean = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { oct2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: combinedRegion, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).evaluate((result, error) => { if (error) reject(error); else resolve(result.total_precipitation_sum); }); }); const jan2024Mean = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { jan2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: combinedRegion, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).evaluate((result, error) => { if (error) reject(error); else resolve(result.total_precipitation_sum); }); }); // Get climatology for October (1991-2020) const octClimatology = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1991, 2020, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(10, 10, 'month')) .select('total_precipitation_sum') .mean(); // Get climatology for January (1991-2020) const janClimatology = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1991, 2020, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 1, 'month')) .select('total_precipitation_sum') .mean(); const octClimoMean = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { octClimatology.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: combinedRegion, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).evaluate((result, error) => { if (error) reject(error); else resolve(result.total_precipitation_sum); }); }); const janClimoMean = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { janClimatology.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: combinedRegion, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).evaluate((result, error) => { if (error) reject(error); else resolve(result.total_precipitation_sum); }); }); // Validate results if (oct2023Mean === null || jan2024Mean === null || octClimoMean === null || janClimoMean === null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert to mm for readability (ERA5 is in meters) console.log(`Oct 1, 2023 rainfall: ${(oct2023Mean * 1000).toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Oct 1991-2020 avg daily: ${(octClimoMean / 31 * 1000).toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Jan 4, 2024 rainfall: ${(jan2024Mean * 1000).toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Jan 1991-2020 avg daily: ${(janClimoMean / 31 * 1000).toFixed(2)} mm`); // Compare: daily values vs. climatological daily average const octHigher = oct2023Mean > (octClimoMean / 31); const janHigher = jan2024Mean > (janClimoMean / 31); console.log(`October comparison: ${octHigher ? 'Higher' : 'Lower or equal'}`); console.log(`January comparison: ${janHigher ? 'Higher' : 'Lower or equal'}`); if (octHigher && janHigher) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
